sql:
SELECT
  dc.company_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) AS num_open_remote_us_listings
FROM fct_posting AS fp
JOIN dim_company AS dc
  ON fp.company_key = dc.company_key
JOIN posting_skills AS ps
  ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.is_canonical_listing = TRUE AND ps.skill = 'evals'
GROUP BY
  dc.company_name
ORDER BY
  num_open_remote_us_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
